reply.subject: Re: Dropped class, charge, portal, and software
reply.body: Since you dropped in week three, you should receive a 50% refund; refunds return to the original payment method within 10 business days. I'm escalating the portal login error and your Friday transcript deadline to a specialist because both need account access. Once the portal works, order your official transcript through the National Student Clearinghouse under Records > Transcripts: electronic is $8 and usually arrives within one business day, paper is $12 and takes 5-7 business days. For free software, use software.codis.edu with your campus account to get Microsoft 365, JetBrains, GitHub Student Developer Pack, and VMware. Next step: please reply with the portal error code so I can attach it to the escalation.
